name: Enums with associated values & pattern matching

Beginner.learningGoal: Model a closed set of cases with an enum and switch exhaustively.
gotchas: default branches hide new cases when the enum grows
Associated values are bound by pattern, not accessed as properties
Raw values and associated values cannot be mixed in one enum
goodSolutionShows: Enum modelling states that cannot be invalid
Methods and computed properties on the enum
shapeHints: payment methods with card, cash and voucher
a network response with success, empty and failure

Intermediate.learningGoal: Use pattern matching with where clauses, tuple patterns and if case / guard case.
gotchas: Binding with let inside a pattern vs outside produces different results with multiple cases
where applies to the pattern, not the whole switch
Pattern order matters; the first matching case wins
goodSolutionShows: case let with where for guarded patterns
if case and guard case for single-case checks
shapeHints: pricing rules over order type and membership tier
a command parser returning an enum
state machine transitions from (state, event) tuples

Advanced.learningGoal: Design recursive and indirect enums with pattern matching, and evolve enums safely.
gotchas: indirect is required for recursive cases
@unknown default and frozen vs non-frozen enums
Equatable and Hashable synthesis fails with non-Equatable associated values
goodSolutionShows: indirect enum evaluating an expression tree
Small transformation function (simplify) via pattern matching
shapeHints: an arithmetic expression evaluator and simplifier
a JSON-like value enum with a path lookup
a linked list or binary tree as indirect enum
